ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (40) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Внешний» (vneshniy, 'external') and «внутренний» (vnutrenniy, 'inner') are kept as a pair, and «власть» (vlast') in Lesigne's list is 'authority'. The line 'One demands monopoly for the state…' is translated where the source prints it, after Lesigne's attribution; Martha's «одно только на потребу» (odno tol'ko na potrebu) is 'only one thing is needful'.

Source observation: [22] The line «Один требует монополии для государства; другой желает уничтожения всех монополий.» stands after the attribution «Эрнест Лесинь.», outside the quotation, at the head of p. 449; it evidently belongs to Lesigne's list of contrasts (blocks 16–19). Translated as printed, in place.

Source observation: [25] «Может ли быть что-нибудь смешнее, по своей очевидной нелепости, такого рассуждения.» is a question («Может ли», mozhet li, 'can … be') ending with a period; translated with a question mark.
